claim: Across nine named QVBS benchmarks and ten trials per benchmark, the empirical policy-reachability curve converges at median stage 2 and mean stage 2.3, earlier than the Dining Philosophers value bounds near stage 16.
acceptance: Complete pinned 9x10 protocol; independently reconstructed aggregation; exact fixed-policy reachability intervals reported alongside the paper's Monte Carlo metric; missing-trial control rejected.
